content:
Solving the CRT system from the reflection:
\[
N\equiv -p \pmod{24},\quad N\equiv -q \pmod{32},\quad N\equiv -r \pmod{36},\quad N\equiv -s \pmod{54}.
\]
The moduli have lcm \(864\), so the solution is unique modulo \(864\).

Compatibility requires
\[
q\equiv p \pmod 8,\quad q\equiv r \pmod 4,\quad q\equiv s \pmod 2,\quad r\equiv s \pmod 9,\quad p\equiv s \pmod 3.
\]
Set \(N=-q+32t\). To satisfy the \(27\)-adic condition:
\[
-q+32t\equiv -s \pmod{27}
\]
\[
5t\equiv q-s \pmod{27}
\]
\[
t\equiv 11(q-s)\pmod{27}.
\]
Thus
\[
N\equiv -q+32\cdot 11(q-s)
=351q-352s
\equiv 351q+512s \pmod{864}.
\]
So the least positive \(N\) is the least positive residue of \(351q+512s\) modulo \(864\).

\[
\boxed{N \equiv 351q+512s \pmod{864}}
\]
